profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Meta | Instagram
profile.summary:
Software Engineer at Instagram focused on full-stack & mobile development and GenAI. Building genAI mobile features within meta. Passionate about UX, exploring the new landscape of human computer interactions and crafting seamless AI enhanced experiences.

Passionate about genai tooling and (trying) to stay at the forefront of agentic development
